sources.excerpt: The supervisor checked C-104 revision 8. The note references an urgent request but omits W-204. Customer, date and timing align with EX-731; the missing request identifier makes this join provisional.

sources.title: Verification service clarification
sources.scope: Received after submission; standard and urgent routes
sources.excerpt: Both checks consult the registered customer-contact record. A separately maintained callback directory applies to standard payments only. No independent urgent-route source or post-change operating test is established by this clarification.
